cells.description: Independent A/B login/bootstrap identities and cookie isolation.
Same-account takeover changes only that account's Sudoku controller.
Unauthorized/solo/secret views and recovery remain private.
Origin/CSRF checks work on actual LAN dev and strict production HTTPS.
Concurrent wrong-password failures enforce atomic account/IP limits.
Session expiry/logout revokes matching sockets and submissions.
Private choices/solutions/session data absent from public caches/bundles/logged evidence.
Concurrent appearance/accent conflicts preserve valid account preferences.
Remote invitation accepts from UI with both possible creators.
Canonical accepted Ready indicators/start update without reload.
B re-login/takeover reconciles its own generation while A stays interactive.
Sudoku Duel starts together and accepts simultaneous private A/B edits.
Together retains exactly one shared controller with explicit transfer.
Remote separate-account WebSocket/background/reconnect and HTTP fallback work.
Saved Practice resumes by its actual sole participant for either account.
Saved unpublished Challenge resumes its sender.
Saved published Async receiver resumes without completed sender acknowledgment.
Saved Duel needs correct resume acknowledgments and becomes history-only.
Saved Remote turn/secret game resumes with correct participants/phase.
Saved Together resumes controller and correct outstanding secret handoff.
No automatic loss after continuous connection loss beyond thirty minutes.
No saved expiry after time beyond seventy-two hours; explicit abandon frees slots.
Uncertain creation/move/secret receipt recovery reuses IDs and rejects stale/duplicate/racing actions.
Projection failure/retry, competing completion/resign and legacy deadline events cannot duplicate terminal results.
Labeled color swatches/player controls submit real settings and explain conflicts.
Phone Back remains reachable and deep links use app-local fallback.
Android/browser Back closes sheets safely and preserves match/secret state.
Leave/save/resign/abandon are distinct legal-action-gated confirmed flows.
Home/setup/Vault expose saved mode-aware Resume states.
Secret lock/refresh/blur immediately masks pixels and accessibility tree.
Remote RPS next-round interruption cannot strand reveal overlay.
Together Cricket repeated scoring retains batter until OUT with correct names/roles.
Accepted movement interrupted by offline/background/navigation settles without inaccurate targeting.
Live reduced-motion changes cancel travel/countdown and retain equivalent information.
Bottom nav/keyboard/landscape/safe areas/200-percent text/largest grids remain reachable.
Sheet focus survives accepted updates; terminal celebration/rematch occurs once.
Comparable cold/warm route loading and input measurements with stated conditions.
Only needed route/game chunks load; public JS budget is measured.
Minimal public precache/current fonts/stale chunks/cold offline have actionable recovery.
Repeated route/resume loops release listeners/sockets/timers and bound background polling.
Sample important motion/input frame traces without per-frame authoritative state updates.
Unknown routes/assets/game/match plus 401/403/404/409/429/503/invalid JSON have useful bounded recovery.
Account-specific production dry-run/bindings/exact Origin/secrets/provisioning and external KDF gate documented.
PWA manifest/icons/update/standalone navigation never cache private data or force active-match reload.
